facts.fact: Local Falcon's whitepaper found Google AI Overviews appeared in 40.2% of 60,000 local-business queries measured on April 7, 2025.
facts.quote: Google AI Overviews appeared in **40.2% of 60,000 local-business queries** measured on April 7, 2025

facts.fact: A separate 2025 study reported an average AI Overview prevalence of 68% across local business-type queries.
facts.quote: A separate 2025 study reported an average prevalence of **68%** across local business-type queries

facts.fact: Research summarized in 2026 found AI Overviews on only 15% of simple local-intent queries, such as city-plus-service searches.
facts.quote: Research summarized in 2026 found AI Overviews on only **15% of simple local-intent queries**, such as city-plus-service searches.

facts.fact: The Search Engine Land analysis reported AI Overviews on 92% of informational queries.
facts.quote: The same analysis reported them on **92% of informational queries** and **97% of hybrid-intent queries**

facts.fact: The Search Engine Land analysis reported AI Overviews on 68% of local searches overall.
facts.quote: The analysis also reported AI Overviews on **68% of local searches overall**, compared with local packs on **39%** of queries.

facts.fact: The Search Engine Land analysis reported local packs on 39% of queries.
facts.quote: compared with local packs on **39%** of queries

facts.fact: QuickFeedback's independent analysis found a 61% organic CTR drop on queries where an AI Overview appeared, from 1.76% to 0.61%.
facts.quote: One independent analysis found a **61% organic CTR drop**, from **1.76% to 0.61%**, on queries where an AI Overview appeared.

facts.fact: Another analysis cited by the page reported a 58% reduction in top-position CTR.
facts.quote: Another reported a **58% reduction in top-position CTR**.

facts.fact: Adwave, in its own description, offers an AI-powered platform that can create broadcast-ready ads from a website URL and distribute them across premium channels including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: Adwave offers an AI-powered platform that can create broadcast-ready ads from a website URL and distribute them across premium channels including **NBC, Hulu, and ESPN**.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its workflow covers creative generation, audience targeting, launch, pacing, and performance tracking for television ads.
facts.quote: Its workflow covers creative generation, audience targeting, launch, pacing, and performance tracking

facts.fact: The page advises that businesses should not claim an AI Overview automatically produces foot traffic or sales.
facts.quote: Do not claim that an Overview automatically produces foot traffic or sales.

facts.fact: The page cites LLMrefs' 2026 AI Overview guide as a source of broader implementation guidance for AI Overview optimization.
The page recommends setting up a simple monthly review of AI Overview performance for local businesses.
facts.quote: Set up a simple monthly review.

facts.fact: The page advises keeping a fixed list of priority local queries split into three intent types: local, informational, and hybrid.
facts.quote: Keep a fixed list of priority local queries, separated into local, informational, and hybrid intent.

facts.fact: The page recommends recording, for each priority query, whether an AI Overview appears, which businesses or pages it names, which sources it cites, and whether the Google Business Profile receives calls, direction requests, messages, or bookings.
facts.quote: Record whether an AI Overview appears, which businesses or pages it names, which sources it cites, and whether your GBP receives calls, direction requests, messages, or bookings.

facts.fact: The page states that a drop in clicks on informational queries may call for better citation-ready answers, while weak performance on simple local searches points back to profile accuracy, reviews, categories, and proximity.
facts.quote: A drop in clicks on informational queries may require better citation-ready answers, while weak performance on simple local searches points back to profile accuracy, reviews, categories, and proximity.
